evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: Creates game metadata; does not impose rules that contradict other stories.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: Specifies an invitation mechanism; not incompatible with other permissions or constraints.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: Describes UI for starting a round; no conflicting behavior or constraint with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Requires visibility of items for the session; not inconsistent with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selection capability does not conflict with other constraints.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Allows adding items during session; not directly contradictory to other stories.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Editing items is not inconsistent with other requirements.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Local removal of items does not conflict with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately ... even though not all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: This allows revealing estimates before all have played, which contradicts participant stories that require simultaneous reveal after all estimators have given their estimate.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Defines a moderator action (accept average); no incompatible rule elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Auto-fill based on unanimous card is consistent with reveal-after-all semantics and does not conflict with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Allows entering a final agreed value; not incompatible with other rules.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimation is compatible with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Importing stories does not impose contradictory constraints with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Alternate import mechanism; no conflict.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing previous games expects persistence but does not directly conflict with deletion policies unless they state permanent removal; not inherently inconsistent.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Viewing transcripts is consistent with other stories; not directly incompatible.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Export capability does not conflict with other requirements.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Export capability does not conflict with other requirements.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game, so that stories and estimates for this game are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Removing stored games/estimates conflicts with the research story that requires results to be stored (albeit non-identifiably) for study.

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Account creation does not conflict with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Authentication requirement does not contradict other stories.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Account modification is not incompatible with other requirements.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account, so that account information and games are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: This deletion requirement conflicts with the research requirement to retain results for study (PP-052) and with any story-level requirement to keep games available indefinitely.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Presentation of times is not inconsistent with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder requirement does not conflict with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, ...} or {0, 1, 2, ...}
evaluations.rationale: Choice of card sets is not incompatible with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Sets a maximum team size; not contradictory with other requirements.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Join-by-name via URL is compatible with account and invite stories.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Viewing the current item is not in conflict with other behavior rules.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Session item list visibility does not contradict other requirements.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Showing that someone has given an estimate (presence indicator) is compatible with hiding values until reveal; not a conflict.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Requires simultaneous reveal only after all have given estimates, which conflicts with moderator story allowing immediate reveal before all have given (PP-009).

evaluations.evidence: be able to change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Defines reveal timing tied to last person selecting; incompatible with moderator's ability to show estimates early (PP-009) which would prevent changes up to that point.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Historical visibility of prior estimates does not conflict with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Showing per-round attributions is compatible with other stories (does not mandate storage policy).

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Timer capability does not conflict with other behaviors or constraints.

evaluations.evidence: two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Timer reset rule does not contradict other stories.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Browsing prior rounds is consistent with other stories and not inherently contradictory.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: UI ordering requirement does not conflict with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: This participant constraint (change until draw completion) may be negated if moderator is permitted to reveal estimates early (PP-009); thus it conflicts with PP-009 and related reveal-after-all stories.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Displaying thumbnails during play is not inconsistent with other stories; storage/anonymity requirements refer to stored research data, not live display.

evaluations.evidence: site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Development standard compliance does not conflict with other functional stories.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Glossary creation is not in conflict with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Performance optimization does not impose conflicting behaviors with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: application function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Browser compatibility goal does not contradict other stories.

evaluations.evidence: site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility requirement is not inconsistent with other specifications.

evaluations.evidence: have the application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Performance/response requirement does not conflict with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Unicode support is compatible with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: URL design requirement does not conflict with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Error page requirement does not impose conflicting rules with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Researcher requirement to store results (even non-identifiably) conflicts with stories that require deletion of games/account (PP-020, PP-024) which remove stored results.

evaluations.evidence: be able to see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Metrics visibility is compatible with storage and privacy policies as long as anonymization is handled; not directly contradictory here.
